question: How should partial falsity in such cases be understood in light of recognition of īśvara?
premises: Some falsity is admitted in a limited respect.
The case under discussion is demonstratively indicated.
Understanding is guided by the doctrine of recognition of īśvara.
inference: Any partial falsity here must be understood in accordance with the recognition of īśvara.
uncertainties: īśvarapratyabhijñātaḥ may refer to the text or to the doctrine; taken here as the doctrinal source.
plain_english: This partial falsity should be understood in light of the recognition of īśvara.
